import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    score_feed = inputs["score_feed"]
    score_snapshot_old = inputs["score_snapshot"]

    # Step 1: STG_CURR = SELECT account_id, AVG(score) AS avg_score
    #         FROM score_feed GROUP BY account_id
    stg_curr = (
        score_feed.groupby("account_id", as_index=False)["score"]
        .mean()
        .rename(columns={"score": "avg_score"})
    )

    # Step 2: DELTA computed against the OLD (pre-update) snapshot
    merged = stg_curr.merge(
        score_snapshot_old[["account_id", "avg_score"]].rename(
            columns={"avg_score": "prev_avg_score"}
        ),
        on="account_id",
        how="left",
    )
    merged["prev_avg_score"] = merged["prev_avg_score"].fillna(0)
    merged["score_delta"] = merged["avg_score"] - merged["prev_avg_score"]

    delta = merged[["account_id", "score_delta"]].copy()

    # Step 3: SCORE_SNAPSHOT is fully replaced by STG_CURR (post-update state)
    score_snapshot_new = stg_curr[["account_id", "avg_score"]].copy()

    return {
        "delta": delta,
        "score_snapshot": score_snapshot_new,
    }
